excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。
excerpt.en: Our [From.GetShipCategoryName] cloning efforts have resulted in a genetic breakthrough. It might be possible to combine these creature's unique anatomy with our expertise in gene manipulation to create a unique type of Mutation.

title.zh: 晶态实体变异计划完成

texts.zh:
我们关于晶态实体的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：分裂核心

通过对它们晶体基因的这种修改，每个生物在遭受严重创伤时能够分裂成两个独立的个体。这将极大地提高它们的战斗能力。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Crystalline Entities is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: Fissile Cores

With this modification to their crystalline genetics, each creature is capable of splitting into two independent organisms in the event of severe trauma. This should drastically improve their combat capabilities.

texts.zh: 在战斗测试中，一些我们的晶体实体在被摧毁后完美地分裂成两半。这些碎片保持着重要的生命迹象，并继续存活了一段时间。
texts.en: In combat testing, a number of our Crystalline Entities have split perfectly in two after being destroyed. These fragmented halves have maintained vital life signs and continued to live for a short time.
